BiblicalUsage: Seirah is the place Ehud escaped to, passing beyond the quarries after he slew Eglon, and the King James Version spells it Seirath. It is named once, as the refuge of a judge on the run.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the place is remembered because the man who escaped to it had just delivered Israel, and God keeps the ground His deliverers stood on.
